newsitem.title: USA: Prince George's Cty, Md., plan prompts opposition.
newsitem.headline: Prince George's Cty, Md., plan prompts opposition.

text.p: Montgomery County, Md., officials said they would oppose a plan to give $250 million to Prince George's County schools during the next session of the General Assembly.
Gov Parris Glendening told legislative leaders he would propose an aid package for Prince George's County similar to the one given Baltimore City schools earlier this year.
The governor said Prince George's schools need the funds for a building and modernization program in order to end a 25- year-old federal student busing program.
Republicans called the plan an election year giveaway.
